title.zh: 每个变化之律下的复现
title.en: Recurrence under every law of change

statement.en: With every configuration listed, a determined law merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns, exactly where it keeps every possibility, and a never-falling quantity that rises rules that out; a kept history merges nothing, never returns and is held by no list; a listed present forgets.
statement.zh: 有列表持有每个构型时，确定之律不合并，恰当每个构型回返，恰当它保留每个可能，而从不下降的量上升则排除不合并；保留的历史不合并、从不回返、没有列表持有它；列表所持有的当下会遗忘。

laws.en: Pigeonhole, with no decidability: for any list l and sequence g with g n in l for every n up to the length of l, some i < j up to that length have g i = g j, membership used as given. A sequence a list holds revisits from every step on, and so does every run of every process whose configurations a list holds.
laws.zh: 鸽巢，不用可判定性：对任一列表 l 与序列 g，若对每个不超过 l 长度的 n 有 g n 在 l 中，则有 i < j 且 j 不超过该长度使 g i = g j，成员关系按所给使用。列表所持有的序列从每一步起都重访，构型为列表所持有的每个过程的每个运行亦然。

laws.en: Never revisiting needs openness: a sequence that never meets one configuration twice has, for no list l, all of its first l.length + 1 values in l, and no list holds the sequence.
laws.zh: 从不重访需要开放：从不两次遇到同一构型的序列，对任何列表 l，它的前 l.length + 1 个值都不全在 l 中；没有列表持有这个序列。

laws.en: A quantity marks the changes of a sequence where it never falls along it and rises across every step at which the configuration changes. Where a list holds the configurations of a sequence, or of a run of any process, and a quantity marks its changes, change does not recur: not every step has a later change. While change recurs within a list, no quantity marks it.
laws.zh: 量标记序列的变化，是指它沿序列从不下降，且在构型改变的每一步上升。列表持有一个序列（或任一过程的一个运行）的构型、且有量标记其变化时，变化不复现：并非每一步之后都还有变化。变化在列表内复现时，没有量标记它。

laws.en: A determined law next on configurations of any kind is a process of the spine with one move, the step to next s, and its orbit from s is the run of that process from s.
laws.zh: 任何类型构型上的确定之律 next 是脊柱的一个过程，只有一个动作，即走到 next s 的一步；它从 s 出发的轨道就是该过程从 s 出发的运行。

laws.en: Under a determined law, a configuration that cannot be had n steps on cannot be had at any later step; for every process, a configuration not reachable from t is not reachable from anything reachable from t; and configurations merged stay merged, their orbits agreeing from the first step on.
laws.zh: 确定之律下，n 步之后不能有的构型在之后任何一步都不能有；对每个过程，从 t 不可达的构型，从 t 可达的任何构型也都不可达；被合并的构型保持合并，其轨道从第一步起相同。

laws.en: A configuration returns where some positive number of steps leads it back to itself. Where every configuration returns, the law merges nothing, two configurations with one successor being equal; for every process a configuration that returns can be had at every step; and where s returns, further steps lead from next s back to s.
laws.zh: 构型回返，是指某个正的步数把它带回自身。每个构型都回返时，律不合并（后继相同的两个构型相等）；对每个过程，回返的构型在每一步都能有；s 回返时，从 next s 出发的若干步回到 s。

laws.en: Where a list holds every configuration, a determined law merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns, and every configuration returns exactly where every configuration can be had at every step.
laws.zh: 有列表持有每个构型时，确定之律不合并，恰当每个构型都回返；每个构型都回返，恰当每个构型在每一步都能有。

laws.en: Where a list holds every configuration: if every configuration can be had as many steps on as the list is long, the law merges nothing; and a law that merges two configurations does not have every configuration reachable that many steps on.
laws.zh: 有列表持有每个构型时：若每个构型在列表长度那么多步之后都能有，律就不合并；合并两个构型的律，并非每个构型在那么多步之后都能有。

laws.en: A determined law that merges nothing and under which some configuration does not return has no list holding every configuration.
laws.zh: 不合并、且某个构型在其下不回返的确定之律，没有列表持有每个构型。

laws.en: Where a list holds every configuration and the law merges nothing, a quantity that never falls along an orbit keeps its value along it; so, with such a list, where a quantity never falls along an orbit and rises at some step of it, it is not the case that the law merges nothing.
laws.zh: 有列表持有每个构型且律不合并时，沿轨道从不下降的量沿轨道保持其值；所以有这样的列表时，量沿轨道从不下降而在某一步上升，则并非律不合并。

laws.en: On the natural numbers the three come apart: under the successor on the natural numbers nothing merges, no number returns, zero cannot be had one step on, and every orbit rises at every step; under the predecessor two numbers merge (zero and one), yet every number can be had at every step.
laws.zh: 在自然数上三者分开：自然数的后继之下没有合并、没有数回返、零在一步之后不能有、每条轨道每步上升；前驱之下有两个数合并（零与一），而每个数在每一步都能有。

laws.en: Keeping its history, the present going on by the law and passing into the past, every law merges nothing, never revisits along an orbit and returns no configuration; a kept history with nothing past cannot be had one or more steps on; no list holds a kept history's orbit; and its present goes on by the law itself.
laws.zh: 保留其历史（当下按律继续并转入过去）时，每个律都不合并，沿轨道从不重访，不让任何构型回返；没有过去的保留历史在一步或更多步之后不能有；没有列表持有保留历史的轨道；其当下按律本身继续。

laws.en: Where s returns after p > 0 steps, the kept history from s with any past has, p steps on, the present s again and differs from where it began. Where a list holds the configurations an orbit from s passes through, from every step on two steps of the kept history from s with nothing past share one present and differ in history.
laws.zh: s 在 p > 0 步后回返时，从 s 带任意过去出发的保留历史，在 p 步后当下又是 s，而与起点不同。列表持有从 s 出发的轨道所经的构型时，从每一步起，从 s 出发、没有过去的保留历史都有两步当下相同而历史不同。

hypotheses.zh: 无关于展开或变化之律的前提，不用可判定性。“某个列表持有这些构型”不对任何展开假设，作为条件写进用到它的规律之内。
hypotheses.en: No premise about the unfolding or the law of change, and no decidability. That a list holds the configurations is assumed of no unfolding; it is the condition written into each law that uses it.

Commitment of the representation: discrete steps. The equivalence of merging nothing, returning and keeping every possibility is stated for determined laws (next : S → S); revisiting, change not recurring and lost reachability staying lost are stated for every process.
hypotheses.zh: 表示的承诺：离散的步。不合并、回返与保留可能的等价只对确定的律（next : S → S）陈述；重访、变化不复现与失去的可达保持失去对每个过程陈述。

does_not_show.en: Finitely many configurations means that a list holds them, not a cardinality, and no decision of equality comes with it.
does_not_show.zh: “有限多构型”指某个列表持有它们，不是基数，也不附带相等的判定。

does_not_show.en: The equivalence of merging nothing, returning and keeping every possibility is shown for determined laws only, not for processes whose course branches.
does_not_show.zh: 不合并、回返与保留每个可能的等价只对确定的律证明，没有对路径分岔的过程证明。

does_not_show.en: That a rise rules out merging nothing does not exhibit two configurations that merge.
does_not_show.zh: 上升排除不合并，并不给出两个被合并的构型。

does_not_show.en: That a present forgets is two different kept histories sharing one present; no count of what is forgotten is given, which would need equality of configurations decided.
does_not_show.zh: 当下遗忘指两段不同的保留历史共有一个当下；没有给出所遗忘者的计数，那需要构型相等可判定。

does_not_show.en: That change does not recur is a negated recurrence, not a step named after which nothing changes.
does_not_show.zh: “变化不复现”是复现的否定，不是指出某步之后不再变化。

detail.zh: 有限多构型这一条件两个方向都需要：Nat.succ 不合并而不回返、失去开端并且每步上升（Law.succ_open），Nat.pred 合并而保留每个可能（Law.pred_open）。
detail.en: The condition of finitely many configurations is needed both ways: Nat.succ merges nothing yet never returns, loses its beginning and rises at every step (Law.succ_open), and Nat.pred merges yet keeps every possibility (Law.pred_open).

next_delta.en: With equality of configurations decided, count what a finite present forgets as a quantity that never falls along the kept history.
next_delta.zh: 在构型相等可判定时，把有限当下所遗忘者计为沿保留历史从不下降的量。

correspondence.zh: 这是 Ren 2026-10-11 所问“if "lossless exist", can we find a path, to figure out, and prove along the way?”的一条路径，按“zero-premise, zero axiom(we are not physics, we derive further)”不加前提。脊柱的停息规律（continued-change-needs-openness）以平衡与耗散为前提；本结果在其下一层：有限多构型中，无损即回返，箭头排除不合并，不重访需要开放。平衡与第一律之下被围住的家族的构型有限多个，变化是构型的函数时本结果作用于它（Becoming.Entropy 的 Web.Determined）。AI 的读法：无损的交换恰在两处存在，有限多构型中的回返与保留其历史的生成（后者需要开放）；物理学设为前提的低熵开端读作保留的历史的开端，而粗粒化的熵从有序的开端上升需要关于开端的前提，没有陈述（entropy-history-and-record）；熵读作有限当下的遗忘。这些读法不是物理推导。对熵、业与物理学的对应是 AI 的读法。
correspondence.en: This is one path for Ren's question of 11 October 2026, ‘if "lossless exist", can we find a path, to figure out, and prove along the way?’, taken with no premise as Ren asked (‘zero-premise, zero axiom(we are not physics, we derive further)’). The spine's rest laws (continued-change-needs-openness) take balance and dissipation as premises; this result lies a level below: within finitely many configurations, losing nothing is returning, an arrow rules out merging nothing, and never revisiting needs openness. Under balance and the first law an enclosed family has finitely many configurations, and where change is a function of the configuration this result applies to it (Web.Determined of Becoming.Entropy). On the AI's reading lossless exchange exists in exactly two places, return within finitely many configurations and becoming that keeps its history, the latter needing openness; the low-entropy beginning physics supplies reads as the beginning of the kept history, while a coarse-grained entropy rising from an ordered start needs a premise about the start and is not stated (entropy-history-and-record); entropy reads as the forgetting of a finite present. These readings are not physical derivations. The readings as entropy, as karmic passing and as physics are the AI's.

detail.zh: Reach.lost_stays 是其“损失沿延续保持”（loss_persists_along_continuation）在脊柱上的形式；回返与保留每个可能的等价（Law.returns_iff_keeps）在有限多构型中与其“保持全部终点可能恰当可以回返”相应。概念上的联系，不是已证的转换。
detail.en: Reach.lost_stays is the spine's form of its persistence of loss along continuations (loss_persists_along_continuation); the equivalence of returning and keeping every possibility within finitely many configurations (Law.returns_iff_keeps) corresponds to its ‘all endpoint possibilities kept exactly when return is possible’. A conceptual connection, not a proved adapter.

detail.zh: 零前提的对应：有标记的变化在有限多构型中不复现，不重访需要开放；脊柱的停息定理在平衡与耗散之下，以存量为标记。
detail.en: The zero-premise counterpart: a marked change does not recur within finitely many configurations, and never revisiting needs openness; the spine's rest theorem, under balance and dissipation, has the stock as its mark.

detail.zh: 统一计划：不含条件的理论的零前提一线中“对每个变化之律成立的”；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: The unification plan: ‘what holds of every law of change’ in the zero-premise line of the theory without the condition; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: 对每个过程：返回的精确条件，三方等价在路径分支时分开之处。
detail.en: For every process: the exact condition for returning, and where the three-way equivalence comes apart when the course branches.
